title: Fix: tsconfig rootDir excludes tests/ (5 spurious TS6059 errors)
resolution_note: Split into tsconfig.json (src-only production build) + new tsconfig.test.json (extends main, rootDir='.', includes src+tests). package.json typecheck now runs all three configs. Closes the 5 TS6059 errors. Surfaced ~10 pre-existing strict-mode errors in src/core/domain/product-extractor.ts, src/core/usecases/discovery-service.ts, src/core/domain/guide-builder.ts, and uncommitted WIP in src/discovery-demo.ts — tracked as wp-fix-strict-mode-type-errors.

done: Surfaced by the 2026-04-14 swarm evaluation after wp-fix-fwd-discovery-adapter-rust-corruption cleared the other 35 errors.
`tsc --noEmit` reports: `error TS6059: File 'tests/unit/*.test.ts' is not under 'rootDir' 'src'. Matched by include pattern 'tests/**/*.ts' in tsconfig.json`
Affects flatten.test.ts, guide-builder.test.ts, product-extractor.test.ts, response-diff-service.test.ts, spec-input-adapter.test.ts

steps.description: Decide the architecturally correct fix: EITHER remove `tests/**/*.ts` from the main tsconfig's `include` and create a separate `tsconfig.tests.json` that extends the main one with `rootDirs: ['src', 'tests']` and its own `include`, OR change the main tsconfig's `rootDir` to `.` and tighten `include` to `['src/**/*', 'tests/**/*']`. The split-config option is cleaner because the production build shouldn't compile tests.

Implement the chosen split. If split-config: add tsconfig.tests.json, update package.json test script to pass --project tsconfig.tests.json, update main tsconfig to exclude tests. If rootDir fix: widen main tsconfig rootDir and include.
steps.done_condition: `bun run typecheck` passes with zero errors; test runner still finds and executes all .test.ts files
